findings.detail: Fresh lifecycle.verify_candidate(bundle, 'candidates/initial') passed. Registered sources, candidate artifacts, auxiliary check artifacts, task and registry prefix were verified; candidate freeze and decision hashes remained unchanged.

All 17 evidence records equal admitted inputs and registered scoped extracts. BMI 26.5/4.1 kg/m^2, glucose 91.8/9.0 mg/dL from the fixed 18-fold conversion, and directly reported HbA1c 5.6/0.3 percent are the selected mean/individual-SD pairs. Duplicate unit representations are not independent constraints. Source age/sex margins remain contextual.

Static code inspection matches the specification: 375 rows for each of eight sex-by-age-band cells, inclusive integer-uniform ages, independently drawn gamma BMI and scaled-beta glucose/HbA1c, and final permutation preserving all quotas. Exactly 3000 rows and 1500 per sex follow by construction.

Independent exact rational arithmetic confirms positive gamma and beta parameters, means and variances. Gamma BMI has all nonnegative integer moments; bounded demographics, glucose in (0,126), and HbA1c in the disclosed modeling interval (0,100) have finite moments. Generator guards reject nonfinite or boundary draws without clipping. Positive predictor covariance diagonal establishes unique finite population OLS projections under the declared independence law.
The admitted E0 non-marginal operation inventory and numerical_uptake.records are both empty, which is explicitly valid. Thirty-one retained independent checks passed.

All 17 feedback checks are not_computable with null operators; all semantic bindings are unsupported with null source operators and correct evidence/recipe hashes. Law-moment calculations are not represented as source-population replay or target validation.

Biomarker independence, stratum-invariant external marginal transport, gamma/beta shape, and HbA1c upper support are explicit assumptions. Requested zero population slopes follow from factorization and are not empirical association findings. Source estimator, structural and transport uncertainty remain unresolved; no favorable-fit criterion was applied.

No generator import, execution, row sampling, numerical quadrature, target clinical reference, sibling candidate or old experiment was used. Runtime table validity remains for isolated controller execution. Review does not close science, consume trials or deliver final runs.
